Fill the grid using the numbers 1 through 9, placing each digit once in every row, column and 3x3 box.

Each number must appear just once in every row, column and 3x3 box, ensuring a proper Sudoku solution.

Remember to consider the climate impact of printing, check the gas usage, treat this as a temporary twist, and feel the weight of satisfaction when you solve it. Buy next week’s Observer Digital Edition to see the completed puzzle."
